segments.text: Hello! The purpose of this video is to train new students how to use some of the basic equipment that you'll be using in the lab.
segments.zh: 大家好！本视频的目的是培训新生如何使用你们在实验室中会用到的一些基本设备。

segments.text: For example, if you ever need to transfer liquid volumes, you'll probably use a pipetter, also known as a pipette.
segments.zh: 例如，如果你需要转移液体体积，你可能会用到移液器，也叫移液枪。

segments.text: Pipettes come in a range of sizes and can accurately transport volumes as small as 0.2 or as large as 1,000 microliters.
segments.zh: 移液器有各种规格，能准确转移小至 0.2、大至 1,000 微升的体积。

segments.text: The volume range of each pipette is shown on top of its plunger. For example, this P20 pipette can transfer 2 to 20 microliters.
segments.zh: 每支移液器的量程都标在其推杆顶部。例如，这支 P20 移液器可以转移 2 到 20 微升。

segments.text: Sometimes, only the maximum volume of the pipette is shown on the plunger, but the volume range of all pipettes is 10-fold,
segments.zh: 有时推杆上只标出移液器的最大量程，但所有移液器的量程都是 10 倍范围，

segments.text: so this pipette transfers 10 to 100 microliters.
segments.zh: 所以这支移液器转移的是 10 到 100 微升。

segments.text: To change the volume setting on a pipette, rotate the black knob near the top, as shown here.
segments.zh: 要更改移液器的体积设定，请旋转靠近顶部的黑色旋钮，如图所示。

segments.text: Note that since this is a P1000 pipette, one of the digits is shown in red to indicate milliliters.
segments.zh: 注意，由于这是一支 P1000 移液器，其中一位数字以红色显示，表示毫升。

segments.text: The other two digits are shown in black for microliters. Right now, the pipette is set to 1 ml.
segments.zh: 另外两位数字以黑色显示，表示微升。现在这支移液器设定为 1 ml。

segments.text: On a P20 pipette, one of the digits is red to represent nanoliters, while the other two digits are shown in black for microliters.
segments.zh: 在 P20 移液器上，其中一位数字为红色，表示纳升，另外两位数字以黑色显示，表示微升。

segments.text: In this example, the pipette is set to 18.7 microliters.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，移液器设定为 18.7 微升。

segments.text: On a P2 pipette, two of the digits are shown in red, and one is in black for microliters.
segments.zh: 在 P2 移液器上，有两位数字以红色显示，一位以黑色显示，表示微升。

segments.text: In this example, the pipette is currently set to 1.32 microliters.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，移液器当前设定为 1.32 微升。

segments.text: Just as pipettes have unique volume ranges, they also require unique tips.
segments.zh: 正如移液器有各自的量程一样，它们也需要各自专用的吸头。

segments.text: For example, this P1000 requires large, blue tips.
segments.zh: 例如，这支 P1000 需要大号的蓝色吸头。

segments.text: Always make sure that the tips fit on snugly.
segments.zh: 一定要确保吸头套得严实。

segments.text: If the tips fit on loosely or fall off, then they won't work properly, and you'll need to find some other tips.
segments.zh: 如果吸头套得松或者会掉下来，就无法正常工作，你需要另找一些吸头。

segments.text: Pipettes use a two-stop plunger system to transfer liquids.
segments.zh: 移液器采用两档推杆系统来转移液体。

segments.text: The first stop, as shown here, is used to draw up the liquid.
segments.zh: 第一档，如图所示，用于吸取液体。

segments.text: The second stop is used to completely eject the liquid from the tip.
segments.zh: 第二档用于把液体从吸头中完全排出。

segments.text: So, once again, the first stop is used to draw up liquid, while the second stop is used to eject it.
segments.zh: 所以再说一遍，第一档用于吸取液体，第二档用于排出液体。

segments.text: When transferring a sample, begin by pushing the plunger down to the first stop to eject all of the air.
segments.zh: 转移样品时，先把推杆按到第一档，排出所有空气。

segments.text: Then submerge the tip and release the plunger.
segments.zh: 然后把吸头浸入液体，松开推杆。

segments.text: As you eject the sample, push all the way to the second stop to make sure that all the liquid leaves the tip.
segments.zh: 排出样品时，一直按到第二档，确保所有液体都离开吸头。

segments.text: When you are done using the tip, eject it into a sharps box using the ejector button, as shown here.
segments.zh: 吸头用完后，用退吸头按钮把它弹入利器盒，如图所示。

segments.text: If your pipette does not have a working ejector button, you can always take off the tip manually by hand.
segments.zh: 如果你的移液器没有能用的退吸头按钮，你也可以随时用手把吸头取下来。

segments.text: If you ever think a pipette isn't accurate, you can test it using an analytical balance.
segments.zh: 如果你认为某支移液器不准确，可以用分析天平来检测。

segments.text: In this example, we're going to test a P1000 pipette by setting it to 700 microliters.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，我们要检测一支 P1000 移液器，把它设定为 700 微升。

segments.text: Since the density of water is 1 gram per ml, 700 microliters of water should weigh 700 milligrams.
segments.zh: 由于水的密度是每毫升 1 克，700 微升水的重量应为 700 毫克。

segments.text: Begin by tearing a weighboat and then slowly transferring the liquid volume to the weighboat.
segments.zh: 先把称量舟去皮，然后慢慢地把液体转移到称量舟中。

segments.text: Make sure you completely eject all of the liquid, then close the doors on the analytical balance and wait for the reading to stabilize.
segments.zh: 确保把液体全部排出，然后关上分析天平的门，等读数稳定。

segments.text: In this case, the reading is only 541 milligrams, which is much less than the expected 700 milligrams.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，读数只有 541 毫克，远低于预期的 700 毫克。

segments.text: Therefore, the pipette is in dire need of calibration.
segments.zh: 因此，这支移液器急需校准。

segments.text: You should no longer use the pipette for any experiments and immediately let your supervisor know that the pipette needs to be calibrated.
segments.zh: 你不应再用这支移液器做任何实验，并应立即告诉你的主管这支移液器需要校准。

segments.text: If you need to transfer volumes larger than 1 ml, you'll need to use a pipette aid.
segments.zh: 如果需要转移大于 1 ml 的体积，就要用电动移液器。

segments.text: Pipette aids use much larger tips with volume ranges from 2 to 50 ml.
segments.zh: 电动移液器使用大得多的移液管，量程从 2 到 50 ml。

segments.text: Begin by tightly inserting the tip into the pipette aid, then submerge the tip into the liquid.
segments.zh: 先把移液管紧紧插入电动移液器，然后把管尖浸入液体中。

segments.text: Draw liquid up with the top button and eject liquid with the bottom button.
segments.zh: 用上面的按钮吸液，用下面的按钮排液。

segments.text: If at any point you draw liquid too far up, the pipette will stop working.
segments.zh: 如果任何时候你把液体吸得太高，移液器就会停止工作。

segments.text: This is because all pipette aids use an air filter to protect themselves from liquid contamination.
segments.zh: 这是因为所有电动移液器都使用空气过滤器来防止自身被液体污染。

segments.text: Therefore, to get the pipette aid working again, you have to disassemble the pipette head and remove the clogged filter, as shown here.
segments.zh: 因此，要让电动移液器重新工作，你必须拆开移液器头部，取出堵塞的过滤器，如图所示。

segments.text: Once you've removed the clogged filter, you'll need to replace it with a new filter.
segments.zh: 取出堵塞的过滤器后，需要换上一个新的过滤器。

segments.text: Note that syringe filters designed for liquid will not work properly in a pipette aid.
segments.zh: 注意，为液体设计的针头式过滤器在电动移液器中无法正常工作。

segments.text: You must use the air filter specifically designed for your pipette aid.
segments.zh: 你必须使用专为你的电动移液器设计的空气过滤器。

segments.text: Once you have removed the old clogged filter and thoroughly dried all the plastic pieces,
segments.zh: 取出旧的堵塞过滤器，并把所有塑料部件彻底晾干后，

segments.text: reassemble the pipette aid, making sure that the new filter and all the rubber pieces are in the correct orientation.
segments.zh: 重新组装电动移液器，确保新过滤器和所有橡胶部件的方向都正确。

segments.text: Once you put it back together, test it with some liquid to make sure that it works.
segments.zh: 装好之后，用一些液体测试一下，确保它能正常工作。

segments.text: If the pipette aid continues to malfunction, let your supervisor know immediately.
segments.zh: 如果电动移液器仍然故障，请立即告诉你的主管。

segments.text: In addition to transferring liquid volumes, you also have to weigh out a variety of chemicals in your research.
segments.zh: 除了转移液体体积，你在研究中还需要称量各种化学品。

segments.text: To do so, we use balances.
segments.zh: 为此，我们使用天平。

segments.text: Most labs have two types of balances, a crude balance for large masses and an analytical balance for very small masses.
segments.zh: 大多数实验室有两类天平：用于称量大质量的粗天平，以及用于称量极小质量的分析天平。

segments.text: It is very important that you only weigh large masses on the crude balance and small masses on the analytical balance.
segments.zh: 非常重要的是，只在粗天平上称大质量，只在分析天平上称小质量。

segments.text: This is because large masses will actually break the analytical balance,
segments.zh: 这是因为大质量实际上会损坏分析天平，

segments.text: while the crude balance is not accurate enough to precisely weigh small masses.
segments.zh: 而粗天平的精度不足以精确称量小质量。

segments.text: To weigh masses larger than one gram, use a weighboat.
segments.zh: 称量大于一克的质量时，使用称量舟。

segments.text: Insert the weighboat into the analytical balance, close all the doors, and tear it to set the mass to zero.
segments.zh: 把称量舟放入分析天平，关上所有的门，然后去皮，把质量设为零。

segments.text: Then add your chemical.
segments.zh: 然后加入你的化学品。

segments.text: To weigh masses smaller than a gram, use a weighing paper.
segments.zh: 称量小于一克的质量时，使用称量纸。

segments.text: Weighing papers are preferred because they cling less to small powders and crystals.
segments.zh: 首选称量纸，是因为细小的粉末和晶体不太容易粘在上面。

segments.text: Transfer your chemical to the weigh paper using a clean spatula or scupula, as shown here.
segments.zh: 用干净的药匙或药勺把化学品转移到称量纸上，如图所示。

segments.text: Slowly add the chemical to the weigh paper to prevent going over the desired weight.
segments.zh: 慢慢地把化学品加到称量纸上，以免超过所需重量。

segments.text: Check the exact weight by closing the doors on the analytical balance and giving it a few seconds to stabilize.
segments.zh: 关上分析天平的门，等几秒钟让它稳定，再查看精确重量。

segments.text: As long as your spatula is clean, you may return any excess chemical to the original bottle it came from.
segments.zh: 只要你的药匙是干净的，你可以把多余的化学品倒回它原来的瓶子里。

segments.text: If you are ever weighing out a chemical and you accidentally spill some of it on the balance or bench, you'll need to clean it up immediately.
segments.zh: 如果你在称量化学品时不小心洒了一些在天平或台面上，你需要立即清理干净。

segments.text: Begin by removing your weighed-out chemical from the balance.
segments.zh: 先把称好的化学品从天平上拿开。

segments.text: Then use a brush to clean up any spilled powder or crystals.
segments.zh: 然后用刷子清理洒出的粉末或晶体。

segments.text: Once you have it all cleaned up, make sure you properly dispose of the chemical.
segments.zh: 全部清理干净后，确保妥善处置这些化学品。

segments.text: Just like a pipetter, an analytical balance can also become inaccurate over time.
segments.zh: 和移液器一样，分析天平用久了也会变得不准确。

segments.text: To test the accuracy of an analytical balance, you'll need two standardized weights at the upper and lower bounds of the balance.
segments.zh: 要检测分析天平的准确度，你需要两个分别处于天平上限和下限的标准砝码。

segments.text: In this case, we're using 2 and 50 gram weights.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，我们用的是 2 克和 50 克的砝码。

segments.text: Notice that the 2 gram weight is reading 1.998 grams, which is less than 1% inaccurate, so that's pretty good.
segments.zh: 注意，2 克砝码的读数是 1.998 克，误差不到 1%，所以相当不错。

segments.text: Next we test the 50 gram weight, which weighs out to be 49.95 grams.
segments.zh: 接下来我们测 50 克砝码，称出来是 49.95 克。

segments.text: This is also greater than 99.9% accurate, so the balance is working properly.
segments.zh: 准确度也高于 99.9%，所以这台天平工作正常。

segments.text: If these readings were significantly off, we would need to calibrate the balance.
segments.zh: 如果这些读数偏差很大，我们就需要校准天平。

segments.text: Refer the manufacturer's instructions on how to do so, or let your supervisor know immediately.
segments.zh: 请参阅制造商的说明了解如何校准，或者立即告诉你的主管。

segments.text: So just to review, use crude balances for large weights, which is typically anything over about 5 grams.
segments.zh: 所以复习一下，称大重量用粗天平，通常是大约 5 克以上的东西。

segments.text: Use analytical balances for any small weights, anything from 0.1 milligram all the way up to a gram.
segments.zh: 称小重量用分析天平，范围从 0.1 毫克一直到一克。

segments.text: And please clean off the balances and the bench if you spill any chemicals.
segments.zh: 如果洒出任何化学品，请把天平和台面清理干净。

segments.text: Centrifuges are also commonly found in most labs.
segments.zh: 大多数实验室里也常有离心机。

segments.text: They're used to separate particles of different densities by spinning them rapidly to generate a high g-force.
segments.zh: 它们通过高速旋转产生很高的 g 力，用来分离不同密度的颗粒。

segments.text: Since most centrifuges do operate at rather high speeds, it is important that you know how to properly use them
segments.zh: 由于大多数离心机都以相当高的转速运行，你必须知道如何正确使用它们，

segments.text: to avoid damaging the centrifuge or harming yourself.
segments.zh: 以免损坏离心机或伤到自己。

segments.text: The most important thing you need to know about using a centrifuge is that any samples you put on the rotor must be properly balanced.
segments.zh: 使用离心机时你需要知道的最重要的一点是，放在转子上的任何样品都必须正确配平。

segments.text: Use an analytical balance to make sure the weights of your samples are equivalent and adjust them as necessary.
segments.zh: 用分析天平确保你的样品重量相等，必要时进行调整。

segments.text: If you ever have an odd number of samples, you can always use a tube of water to even things out.
segments.zh: 如果你的样品数量是奇数，你随时可以用一管水来配平。

segments.text: When putting your samples on the rotor, make sure they're exactly opposite one another, otherwise you'll get an imbalance error.
segments.zh: 把样品放到转子上时，确保它们彼此正好相对，否则会出现不平衡错误。

segments.text: Next, put a lid on the rotor just in case any of your samples leak out.
segments.zh: 接下来，给转子盖上盖子，以防有样品漏出来。

segments.text: To set the speed on the centrifuge, always begin by selecting either g-force or RPM for revolutions per minute.
segments.zh: 设定离心机转速时，一定要先选择 g 力或 RPM，即每分钟转数。

segments.text: Note that g-force may also be shown as RCF for relative centrifugal force.
segments.zh: 注意，g 力也可能显示为 RCF，即相对离心力。

segments.text: Next, set the time on the centrifuge and start the run.
segments.zh: 接下来，设定离心机的时间，然后开始运行。

segments.text: You should always stick around to watch the centrifuge reach maximum speed just in case there's any kind of imbalance error.
segments.zh: 你应该一直守在旁边，看着离心机达到最高转速，以防出现任何不平衡错误。

segments.text: Once the centrifuge has finished, wait for the rotor to completely stop spinning, then remove your samples.
segments.zh: 离心机运行结束后，等转子完全停止转动，再取出样品。

segments.text: You should always check your samples to make sure the desired sedimentation has occurred.
segments.zh: 你应该随时检查样品，确保已达到所需的沉降效果。

segments.text: When you're done with the centrifuge, put the rotor lid back in place and close the main lid.
segments.zh: 用完离心机后，把转子盖放回原位，并关上主盖。

segments.text: Whenever you're using larger centrifuges that use buckets or 50 ml tubes,
segments.zh: 每当你使用带吊篮或 50 ml 离心管的大型离心机时，

segments.text: it's important that you only fill them up to about 80% of their maximum value.
segments.zh: 重要的是只装到其最大容量的大约 80%。

segments.text: For instance, here we're only filling up the 50 ml tube to 40 ml.
segments.zh: 例如，这里我们只把 50 ml 离心管装到 40 ml。

segments.text: This is because tubes and buckets do not have perfect seals.
segments.zh: 这是因为离心管和吊篮的密封并不完美。

segments.text: Therefore, when they're spun at high speeds, they can leak out if they're overfilled.
segments.zh: 因此，如果装得过满，高速旋转时就可能漏出来。

segments.text: So to prevent making a huge mess that you have to clean up in the centrifuge,
segments.zh: 所以，为了避免在离心机里弄得一团糟、还得自己清理，

segments.text: only fill up 50 ml tubes to 40 ml and fill 600 ml buckets to around 400 ml.
segments.zh: 50 ml 离心管只装到 40 ml，600 ml 吊篮装到约 400 ml。

segments.text: So just to review, when using a centrifuge, always make sure that your samples are properly balanced.
segments.zh: 所以复习一下，使用离心机时，一定要确保样品正确配平。

segments.text: And finally, when using 50 ml tubes or large buckets,
segments.zh: 最后，使用 50 ml 离心管或大吊篮时，

segments.text: only fill them to 80% of their maximum volume to prevent any spills that might happen in the centrifuge.
segments.zh: 只装到其最大容量的 80%，以防在离心机里发生泄漏。

segments.text: If a spill does occur, make sure that you clean it up immediately.
segments.zh: 如果确实发生了泄漏，一定要立即清理干净。

segments.text: The most important thing you need to know about a pH meter
segments.zh: 关于 pH 计，你需要知道的最重要的一点

segments.text: is that the electrode must be stored in electrode storage solution in between uses.
segments.zh: 是在两次使用之间，电极必须保存在电极保存液中。

segments.text: If the electrode storage solution runs dry, then the pH meter will stop working properly
segments.zh: 如果电极保存液干了，pH 计就会无法正常工作，

segments.text: and the electrode may even break.
segments.zh: 电极甚至可能损坏。

segments.text: If you ever notice that the storage solution has run dry,
segments.zh: 如果你发现保存液干了，

segments.text: immediately fill it back up with fresh electrode storage solution.
segments.zh: 请立即重新加满新鲜的电极保存液。

segments.text: Several companies offer pre-made storage solutions,
segments.zh: 有几家公司提供现成的保存液，

segments.text: or you can make your own by mixing 100 mg of potassium chloride with 10 ml of the pH-4 standard solution.
segments.zh: 你也可以自己配制：把 100 mg 氯化钾和 10 ml pH 4 标准溶液混合。

segments.text: When you are ready to use the electrode, remove it from the storage solution
segments.zh: 准备使用电极时，把它从保存液中取出，

segments.text: and thoroughly dry it with a chem wipe.
segments.zh: 用擦镜纸彻底擦干。

segments.text: Next, rinse off the electrode with milli-q water and dry it again.
segments.zh: 接下来，用 Milli-Q 超纯水冲洗电极，再次擦干。

segments.text: To calibrate the meter, pour a little bit of the standard solution into a 15 ml tube.
segments.zh: 校准 pH 计时，倒一点标准溶液到 15 ml 离心管中。

segments.text: This prevents the main standard solution from becoming contaminated.
segments.zh: 这样可以防止原装标准溶液被污染。

segments.text: You can refer to the manufacturer's instructions for specific protocols on how to calibrate your pH meter.
segments.zh: 关于如何校准你的 pH 计，具体操作规程可参阅制造商的说明。

segments.text: However, in general, pH standard solutions of 4, 7, and 10 are usually used to calibrate pH meters.
segments.zh: 不过一般来说，通常用 pH 4、7 和 10 的标准溶液来校准 pH 计。

segments.text: When calibrating the meter, it is important that you use the two standard solutions
segments.zh: 校准 pH 计时，重要的是要使用

segments.text: that are closest to the pH of your buffer.
segments.zh: 与你的缓冲液 pH 最接近的两种标准溶液。

segments.text: For example, if you plan on making a sample with a pH of 6,
segments.zh: 例如，如果你打算配制 pH 为 6 的样品，

segments.text: you want to calibrate with the 4 and 7 standards.
segments.zh: 就应该用 4 和 7 的标准溶液校准。

segments.text: However, if the pH of your buffer will be 8.5,
segments.zh: 但如果你的缓冲液 pH 将是 8.5，

segments.text: then you will want to calibrate the meter with the pH 7 and 10 standard solutions.
segments.zh: 那就应该用 pH 7 和 10 的标准溶液校准 pH 计。

segments.text: To measure pH, completely submerge the tip of the electrode into your solution
segments.zh: 测量 pH 时，把电极尖端完全浸入溶液中，

segments.text: and ensure that it is vigorously mixed.
segments.zh: 并确保溶液被充分搅拌。

segments.text: The best way to do this is to use a stir bar and a stir plate,
segments.zh: 最好的办法是使用搅拌子和磁力搅拌器，

segments.text: but you can do it with your hand if those are unavailable.
segments.zh: 但如果没有这些，也可以用手搅拌。

segments.text: Remember to press the read button on the pH meter and give it a little while to stabilize.
segments.zh: 记得按下 pH 计上的读数按钮，并给它一点时间稳定。

segments.text: Once the reading has stabilized, you can adjust the pH of the solution
segments.zh: 读数稳定后，你可以用盐酸或氢氧化钠

segments.text: with hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide.
segments.zh: 来调节溶液的 pH。

segments.text: Note that hydrochloric acid will decrease the pH while sodium hydroxide will raise the pH.
segments.zh: 注意，盐酸会降低 pH，而氢氧化钠会升高 pH。

segments.text: In either case, add the acid or base in small amounts and vigorously mix the solution after you add them.
segments.zh: 无论哪种情况，都要少量添加酸或碱，加入后充分搅拌溶液。

segments.text: It is important that you add the acid and base in very small amounts
segments.zh: 重要的是要以非常少的量加入酸和碱，

segments.text: such that you don't overshoot and have to add excess acid and base.
segments.zh: 这样就不会调过头，不得不再加入过量的酸和碱。

segments.text: This will prevent you from adding too much salt to your solution.
segments.zh: 这可以防止你在溶液中加入过多的盐。

segments.text: Once you are done titrating your solution, remember to put the electrode back into the storage solution.
segments.zh: 滴定完溶液后，记得把电极放回保存液中。

segments.text: I'd like to stop for a moment to talk specifically about buffers.
segments.zh: 我想停一下，专门谈谈缓冲液。

segments.text: The purpose of a buffer is to maintain the pH of a solution,
segments.zh: 缓冲液的作用是维持溶液的 pH，

segments.text: even though a reaction may be occurring that would otherwise raise or lower the pH.
segments.zh: 即使正在发生的反应本来会使 pH 升高或降低。

segments.text: The most important thing you need to know about buffers
segments.zh: 关于缓冲液，你需要知道的最重要的一点

segments.text: is that they are only effective within specific pH ranges.
segments.zh: 是它们只在特定的 pH 范围内有效。

segments.text: For example, biz Tris buffer is only effective between pH 5.8 and 7.3.
segments.zh: 例如，Bis-Tris 缓冲液只在 pH 5.8 到 7.3 之间有效。

segments.text: Therefore, if you titrate it to pH 8, it will not resist pH change effectively.
segments.zh: 因此，如果你把它滴定到 pH 8，它就不能有效抵抗 pH 变化。

segments.text: Instead, if you need to make a buffer at pH 8, it would be better to use Tris HC out,
segments.zh: 相反，如果你需要配制 pH 8 的缓冲液，最好使用 Tris-HCl，

segments.text: which has a range from 7.2 to 9.
segments.zh: 它的范围是 7.2 到 9。

segments.text: It is important to mention that the buffers shown in this table
segments.zh: 需要说明的是，这张表中列出的缓冲液

segments.text: are only a small sampling of all the buffers available.
segments.zh: 只是所有可用缓冲液中的一小部分。

segments.text: You can find many more online, which may be useful for your experiments.
segments.zh: 你可以在网上找到更多，可能对你的实验有用。

segments.text: Aside from the pH range of a buffer, you should also consider its chemical reactivity.
segments.zh: 除了缓冲液的 pH 范围，你还应考虑它的化学反应性。

segments.text: For example, Tris buffers are weak chelators. That means they will weakly bind metal ions.
segments.zh: 例如，Tris 缓冲液是弱螯合剂。这意味着它们会弱结合金属离子。

segments.text: In addition, Heaps buffers generate free radicals
segments.zh: 此外，HEPES 缓冲液会产生自由基，

segments.text: that can significantly interfere with your chemical reaction if exposed to sunlight.
segments.zh: 如果暴露在阳光下，会严重干扰你的化学反应。

segments.text: Therefore, you should always remember to check the pH range
segments.zh: 因此，你应该始终记得检查缓冲液的 pH 范围

segments.text: and the reactivity of your buffer just to make sure it is ideal
segments.zh: 和反应性，以确保它最适合

segments.text: for the reaction that you are trying to do.
segments.zh: 你要做的反应。

segments.text: If you work with any hazardous chemicals in your research,
segments.zh: 如果你的研究中要用到任何危险化学品，

segments.text: you probably need to use the fume hood at some point.
segments.zh: 你可能在某个时候需要使用通风橱。

segments.text: To begin working in the fume hood, raise the sash to the maximum safe height.
segments.zh: 开始在通风橱中工作时，把视窗拉到最大安全高度。

segments.text: Note that if you raise it too high, the fume hood will not work properly
segments.zh: 注意，如果拉得太高，通风橱就无法正常工作，

segments.text: and some vapors may escape into the lab.
segments.zh: 一些蒸气可能会逸散到实验室中。

segments.text: When you raise the sash, it should start drawing air inwards.
segments.zh: 拉起视窗时，通风橱应开始向内吸气。

segments.text: If there is no air flow or any alarms go off in the hood,
segments.zh: 如果没有气流，或者通风橱发出任何警报，

segments.text: you should let your supervisor know immediately and not use the fume hood.
segments.zh: 你应立即告诉你的主管，并且不要使用这个通风橱。

segments.text: When performing experiments in the fume hood,
segments.zh: 在通风橱中做实验时，

segments.text: you should always work at least 6 inches deep.
segments.zh: 你应始终在至少 6 英寸深处操作。

segments.text: This will prevent any vapors from accidentally escaping from the fume hood.
segments.zh: 这可以防止任何蒸气意外从通风橱中逸出。

segments.text: In addition, you should always keep the fume hood as clean and empty as possible.
segments.zh: 此外，你应始终让通风橱保持尽可能干净和空旷。

segments.text: This will prevent hazardous chemicals from cross-reacting from one another
segments.zh: 这样可以防止危险化学品之间发生交叉反应，

segments.text: and it will ensure that the vents that you can see in the back of the fume hood here
segments.zh: 并确保你在这里通风橱后部看到的这些通风口

segments.text: will remain unblocked and working properly.
segments.zh: 保持畅通、正常工作。

segments.text: Remember, if these vents become blocked, the fume hood may lose suction
segments.zh: 记住，如果这些通风口被堵住，通风橱可能会失去抽吸力，

segments.text: and hazardous vapors may escape into the lab.
segments.zh: 危险蒸气可能会逸散到实验室中。

segments.text: So, to review, before working in the fume hood,
segments.zh: 所以复习一下，在通风橱中工作之前，

segments.text: always check the air flow of the hood.
segments.zh: 一定要检查通风橱的气流。

segments.text: You should also work 6 inches deep at all times
segments.zh: 你还应始终在 6 英寸深处操作，

segments.text: and try not to block any of the vents inside of the fume hood.
segments.zh: 并尽量不要堵塞通风橱内的任何通风口。

segments.text: Another commonly used piece of equipment in all of our labs
segments.zh: 我们所有实验室中另一种常用设备

segments.text: is the Ultra Pure Water System.
segments.zh: 是超纯水系统。

segments.text: Ultra Pure Water should be used for all of your buffers
segments.zh: 你所有的缓冲液都应使用超纯水，

segments.text: since tap water and even distilled water may have some contaminants
segments.zh: 因为自来水甚至蒸馏水都可能含有一些污染物，

segments.text: that could interfere with your reactions.
segments.zh: 可能会干扰你的反应。

segments.text: To collect Ultra Pure Water, place the dispensing hose inside your bottle
segments.zh: 接取超纯水时，把出水管放进你的瓶子里，

segments.text: and pull the trigger as shown here.
segments.zh: 然后扣动扳机，如图所示。

segments.text: Do not let bottles fill up on the bench.
segments.zh: 不要让瓶子在台面上接水。

segments.text: Instead, put them in the sink just in case you forget about them and they overflow.
segments.zh: 而是把它们放在水槽里，以防你忘了它们导致水溢出来。

segments.text: Please note that if you do leave a bottle on the bench and it overflows,
segments.zh: 请注意，如果你把瓶子留在台面上并且水溢了出来，

segments.text: it can flood the lab, thereby damaging or ruining many expensive pieces of lab equipment.
segments.zh: 可能会淹了实验室，从而损坏或毁掉许多昂贵的实验设备。

segments.text: When collecting Ultra Pure Water, you should always check the readout on the system
segments.zh: 接取超纯水时，你应始终查看系统上的读数，

segments.text: to ensure that the water is ultra pure.
segments.zh: 确保水是超纯的。

segments.text: Ultra Pure Water has a resistivity of 18.2 mega ohms per centimeter,
segments.zh: 超纯水的电阻率为 18.2 兆欧每厘米，

segments.text: as shown on the readout here.
segments.zh: 如这里的读数所示。

segments.text: If the resistivity is any lower, that means your water is not ultra pure
segments.zh: 如果电阻率更低，就意味着你的水不是超纯水，

segments.text: and one of the filters in the system will likely need to be replaced.
segments.zh: 系统中的某个过滤器可能需要更换。

segments.text: Notify your supervisor if this is the case.
segments.zh: 如果出现这种情况，请通知你的主管。

segments.text: Also notify your supervisor if you observe any alarms on the system.
segments.zh: 如果你发现系统有任何警报，也请通知你的主管。

segments.text: Once you have your Ultra Pure Water, you probably use a stir plate to make your solution.
segments.zh: 拿到超纯水后，你可能会用磁力搅拌器来配制溶液。

segments.text: Begin by inserting a stir bar that isn't too big or too small for the bottle.
segments.zh: 先放入一个对这个瓶子来说不太大也不太小的搅拌子。

segments.text: Then slowly turn up the RPMs and add your chemical that you wish to dissolve.
segments.zh: 然后慢慢调高转速，并加入你要溶解的化学品。

segments.text: In some cases, you may wish to heat the sample as well.
segments.zh: 在某些情况下，你可能还需要加热样品。

segments.text: Please remember to use extreme caution when heating liquids on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 在加热板上加热液体时，请务必格外小心。

segments.text: For example, do not heat water above its boiling point,
segments.zh: 例如，不要把水加热到沸点以上，

segments.text: which can be 90 to 100 degrees C unless you are explicitly trying to boil it.
segments.zh: 沸点可能是 90 到 100 摄氏度，除非你明确就是要把它煮沸。

segments.text: Volatile solvents should only be heated in the chemical fume hood
segments.zh: 挥发性溶剂只能在化学通风橱中加热，

segments.text: to avoid inhalation of any harmful vapors.
segments.zh: 以免吸入任何有害蒸气。

segments.text: Finally, hot plates should not be left on at high temperatures for extended periods of time.
segments.zh: 最后，加热板不应长时间在高温下开着。

segments.text: For example, try not to leave a hot plate on overnight,
segments.zh: 例如，尽量不要让加热板整夜开着，

segments.text: since it is not uncommon for hot plates to overheat and create a fire hazard when left unattended.
segments.zh: 因为加热板在无人看管时过热并引发火灾隐患的情况并不少见。

segments.text: So, that's the end of this video. I hope it's been useful.
segments.zh: 好了，本视频就到这里。希望对你有所帮助。

segments.text: Please contact your advisor if you have any more questions on any of these pieces of equipment.
segments.zh: 如果你对这些设备还有任何问题，请联系你的导师。
